terra.problem: The passage does not say the people can see the siege from their front doors.
Calling the baker’s answer a big leap sounds like a rebuke.
The speaker says the sickness must be borne, but does not say it cannot be waited out.
The text says all the flock is scattered, not that it is scattered everywhere.
Desolation is in the text, but the passage does not explicitly say the cities are empty.
The passage does not say nobody is crowding the streets.
The first-person quotation needs a lead-in identifying it as the prayer.
The passage does not say the one praying knows how small he is. It also does not give that as the reason for the request; a guessed reason is still an added reason.
